cr_data.provenance: Estate of the artist, 1986; The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, Abiquiu, New Mexico, 1991 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Shown: Photo Succession Gallery, ~~1915~~ 1916?" {"1915" crossed out}. Not recorded Whitney Archive. Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1915. Not included in 1916 exhibition. Dated 1916 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence; completed either in Virginia or Texas. See cat. no. 45. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A group of thin, pale gray lines curl inward around a central point. A thin center line rises above the others, appearing to uplift a shining black oval. A black arch shape frames the scene.
imageCaption: Courtesy of National Gallery of Art.
